title: Schedule C activity
description: One sole-proprietorship business, in the collapsed intake the pinned dictionary itself uses: lines 8 through 27a, home-office and vehicle detail are one filer-supplied line 28 total. Line 28 is required alongside line 1 because the engine's net-profit chain never resolves without it — a blank line 28 is an unread answer, not zero expenses. For a business whose line 31 is a loss, line G and box 32a become questions (asked, never defaulted): the engine treats both as attested and would take the loss regardless, and this service refuses to state either answer for the filer. Box 32b opens one more question, the simplified Form 6198 amount at risk, and the loss is capped at it rather than refused.

gross_receipts_cents.description: Schedule C line 1, gross receipts or sales.

returns_and_allowances_cents.description: Schedule C line 2, returns and allowances. Absence is sent as zero and stated. Exceeding line 1 is not refused: refunds of a prior year's sales can exceed this year's receipts, and the form itself allows a negative line 3.

cost_of_goods_sold_cents.description: Schedule C line 4, cost of goods sold. Its own field, never folded into total_expenses_cents — the dictionary separated the two on 2026-08-07 because a return carrying COGS in both places subtracts it twice.

other_business_income_cents.description: Schedule C line 6, other income, including federal and state gasoline or fuel tax credit or refund. Absence is sent as zero and stated.

total_expenses_cents.description: Schedule C line 28, total expenses — the dictionary's collapsed intake for lines 8 through 27a plus the home-office and vehicle detail. COGS does NOT belong here (see cost_of_goods_sold_cents).

materially_participated.description: Schedule C line G. Asked only when line 31 is a loss: a No with a loss is refused (Form 8582 passive-activity limits are not supported), and on a profit the answer moves nothing the engine computes.

all_investment_at_risk.description: Schedule C box 32a. Asked only when line 31 is a loss: true takes the loss in full; false is box 32b (some investment is not at risk), which opens one more question beside it — the simplified Form 6198 amount at risk — and the loss is capped at that amount (Form 6198 line 21) rather than refused.

amount_at_risk_cents.description: Amount at risk in this business (IRC 465) — the simplified Form 6198 Part II line 10b figure: the adjusted basis in the activity on the first day of the year, plus increases, less decreases, entered as not less than zero. The line 31 loss is then deducted only up to it (Form 6198 line 21) and the rest carries forward. Asked on EVERY business whose line 31 is a loss and whose box 32b is checked, and only there: on box 32a, before box 32 is answered, or on a business with no loss, supplying it is refused rather than dropped — the dictionary reads this figure only when box 32 is answered and 32b, and only a loss reaches the cap. The cap is per business, as section 465 measures it: each business's own amount at risk caps its own loss. NOT MODELED: the line-by-line Part II build and the detailed Part III of Form 6198, and the mid-year changes Part I covers; this is the single supplied figure the pinned dictionary carries.
